Metadata.title: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026 - Hypernova
Metadata.description: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026: Hypernova - Vietnam’s arena for the next generation of marketing talent.

hero.eyebrow: Kotler Klub - VinUni House of Marketers
hero.description: To reach the brightest glory, you must first dare to step beyond your own limits.

about.title: A new legacy forged through breakthrough
about.lead: Marketing All-Star Challenge (MASC) is an exclusive national marketing competition hosted by Kotler Klub - VinUni House of Marketers.
about.description: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026 draws inspiration from the Hypernova phenomenon - one of the most powerful and rare stellar explosions in the universe. Hypernova represents young Marketers who dare to immerse themselves in a challenging real-world environment, push beyond their limits, and achieve breakthroughs in both thinking and expertise, thereby inspiring the next generation of Marketers.
about.caption: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026 goes beyond an ordinary competition, opening up a space for young Marketers to challenge their creativity and uncover the sharpest solutions to real-world brand problems.

prizes.overline: For the teams that outshine the rest
prizes.title: Breakthrough effort deserves a stellar reward.
prizes.poolDescription: Cash prizes, partner benefits, and career opportunities designed to carry winning ideas beyond the competition.
prizes.grandDescription: Awarded to the MASC 2026 Champion - the team that conquers the dual challenge and demonstrates outstanding real-world execution.
prizes.secondDescription: Recognizing sharp strategic insight, breakthrough creativity, and exceptional execution capabilities.
prizes.impactDescription: Celebrating the campaign that creates the strongest positive impact for society and the community.

eligibility.title: The arena for top marketing talent
eligibility.description: Open to young adults aged 18–22 living and studying in Vietnam who are passionate about marketing and aspiring to pursue a marketing career.
eligibility.achieverDescription: High achievers in prestigious academic Marketing and Business case competitions (Champion, Runner-up, Top 20-50...).
eligibility.leaderDescription: Executive board members of Marketing or Business student clubs at universities.
eligibility.marketerDescription: Finalists/advanced candidates in corporate Management Trainee or Key Talent programs, or Top 20% in MASC'26 Preliminary round.

journey.title: The Journey to Hypernova
journey.description: Explore the comprehensive stages and rounds of Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026.

round05.title: Preliminary Round: The Ignition (Industry Exposure)
round05.summary: A Brand Partner brief becomes the spark for young Marketers to unlock their potential and prove their abilities.
round05.detail: The top 20% of teams advance to Round 1, while the 2 best-performing teams earn direct entry to Round 2.

round1.title: Round 1: The Star Gathering (Mentoring Round)
round1.summary: The top 20% from the Qualifying Round and All-Star applicants gather for a head-to-head challenge.
round1.detail: Each team chooses 1 of 3 mentor-led tracks to sharpen an initial idea into a compelling proposal. The top 2 teams from each track join the top 2 Qualifying Round teams in Round 2.

round2.title: Round 2: The Stellar Forge (Social & Cultural Impact Challenge)
round2.summary: In this forge of ideas, teams face a true test of courage, creativity, and social and cultural impact.
round2.detail: Guided by mentors, teams refine their strategies to solve a partner's communications challenge. The 4 strongest strategies advance to the Real-World Execution Round.

round3.title: Practical Round: The Cosmic Blast (Real Campaign Execution)
round3.summary: The top 4 teams transform their ideas into complete campaigns and create a real-world impact in the market.
round3.detail: With mentor guidance, teams move beyond assumptions to launch, test, and measure genuine results from the market and its customers.

round4.title: Final Round: The Infinite Legacy (Grand Finale)
round4.summary: The top 4 defend their live campaigns before the Jury, turning their journey into a legacy that lasts beyond the competition.
round4.detail: The 2 teams with the strongest campaigns face a live Mini Case at the Grand Finale to crown the MASC'26 Champion and inspire the next generation of Marketers.

criteria.title: What the judges will look for
criteria.round1Description: Choose one of three specialized tracks (Product + Growth, Societal + Marketing Communications, Market Research + Trade Marketing) and refine your solution through 1-on-1 mentor feedback.
criteria.round2Description: Solve the Diamond Sponsor's challenge by balancing breakthrough creativity, practical application, and meaningful positive community impact.
criteria.finaleDescription: Defend live executed campaign results before the judges, then Top 2 solve an unseen Mini Case live on stage under real-time pressure.

mentors.title: Guided by leading industry experts
mentors.description: Meet distinguished leaders and experts from top brands, agencies, and corporations bringing real-world expertise directly to this year's contestants.

mentor1.name: Ms. Ngọc Nguyễn
mentor1.description1: Head of Brand Marketing Department at Canifa
mentor1.description2: Successfully led Canifa's “Say It Now” and “Yêu Nước Từ Trong Nôi” campaigns, backed by over 15 years of experience

mentor2.name: Mr. Duy Nguyễn
mentor2.description1: Brand Business Development Manager at Nestlé

mentor4.name: Ms. Trang Hoàng
mentor4.description3: Mentor for Unilever & Nestlé Vietnam Management Trainee programs

finalCta.title: Push your boundaries,become a Hypernova
finalCta.description: Applications are open July 20 – Aug 7 for ambitious marketing talent aged 18–22 nationwide.
